question: Which of the following is a single chip based device that is a complete processor in itself and is capable of performing arithmetic and logical operations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Microprocessor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A microprocessor is a single chip-based device that is a complete processor in itself and is capable of performing arithmetic and logical operations**__.

 
 
• It is a controlling unit of a micro-computer, fabricated on a small chip.
 
• The microprocessor contains millions of tiny component
